definitions.short: Bosmath , the name of a wife of Esau, and of a daughter of Solomon
definitions.full: H1315. Basemath בָּֽשְׂמִת proper name, feminine ( perfume ?) — 1 Hittite woman, a wife of Esau Gen 26:34 (P); called daughter of Ishmael, and sister of Nebaioth 36:3 (but due probably to R; this daughter of Ishmael is מַחֲלַת in 28:9 P); see also 36:4 , 10 , 13 , 17 (all P) ( ⅏ has מחלת throughout Genesis 36). 2 daughter of Solomon, wife of Ahimaaz 1Kin 4:15 .
